proof.observed: Body `::::ask{urgency="high"}` Outer? / - A: first (holding `:::ask{urgency="low"}` Inner? - X: ex - Y: why) / - B: second. Each shell's own footer holds its own card: the outer card shows rows `A firstInner?X: exY: why` and `B second`, and the inner card rows `X ex`, `Y why` (at 9439f4a8 the reviewer found the outer card mounted in the inner footer, leaving the outer with no options). The inner decision sits inside the outer's folded source list, so it is not visible. The document's version view draws the same body exactly the same way (T13: outer rows `A firstInner?X: exY: why`, `B second`, inner not visible). The live document also hides the inner decision, and its hosted card shows the server's rows `A first`, `B second` and `Other` (T12), with no page error. So the comment matches the document's read-only drawing, which is this issue's contract. The run-on description comes from askBlockFacts reading the option's whole textContent, the same code the version view uses before this change
